result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says no transport compression codec decision is currently recorded, and it names no codec.

The project's memory has no decision on compression. Its records cover HTTPS everywhere, certificate verification on all builds, rustls, and an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL. The only other match was an unrelated "msgpack" note, which is a serialization format, not a compression codec, and it was never recorded as a decision.

I didn't run the initial `mkdir`/`cat` command successfully (it returned a parser error). I wrote the file with the Write tool instead, which created `docs/policies/` along with it.
